newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop to offer more Tuen Mun flats.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop to offer more Tuen Mun flats.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Monday it would put an additional 160 units on offer due to a strong response to its latest sale in Tuen Mun in Hong Kong's New Territories.
A company spokeswoman said 2,106 potential buyers had registered to buy the initial 64 flats at the Villa Tiara development on the first day of registration.
She said the developer would add 160 units for sale at about HK$3,000 per sq ft, a five percent increase over the original price.
The flats, ranging from 604 to 794 sq ft, were initially offered at an average price of HK$2,850 per sq ft
Registration for potential buyers closes on Wednesday and the flats will be put on sale on Saturday, the company said.
Villa Tiara development is expected to be completed in May 1997 and will comprise five 14-storey residential blocks with a total of 556 units.
